description: This Java test class 'AlertValidatorTest' tests the 'AlertValidator' class in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests to verify validation logic for the 'Alert' object, including validation of the alert text field for null, empty, whitespace, and length constraints.

classes.name: AlertValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that validates the behavior of the AlertValidator in the OpenMRS project, ensuring correct validation logic for Alert objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the AlertValidator, Alert, and Errors objects before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfAlertTextIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the alert text is null.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfAlertTextIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the alert text is empty.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfAlertTextIsOnlyWhitespaces
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the alert text contains only whitespace characters.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredValuesAreSet
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required alert fields are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the alert text exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: assertThatFieldTextHasError
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the 'text' field has validation errors.
